name: git_diff
label: change diff
criteria: Read the code change under investigation: commits and diff against the known-good revision

name: plot
label: chart
criteria: Draw a chart of the latest run (frame times or memory) to show the problem

name: write_test
label: write a regression check
criteria: Write a regression check from the evidence and prove it fails on this revision and passes on the known-good one

name: write_fix
label: write a fix
criteria: Write a code fix on a branch, build it, and run the regression check against it

name: open_pr
label: open a pull request
criteria: Open a pull request with the fix, the regression check and the evidence
